Evaluate replication-state parameters on a grid

Source: R/tune_states.R
evaluate_state_parameters.Rd

For every row of param_grid, run assign_replication_states() followed by compute_rep_percent() and summarise how many cells end up with a replicated fraction inside target_range. Optionally the evaluation is run on a random pilot subset of n_cells cells. A failing combination is recorded with status = "error" instead of stopping the whole grid. Use rank_state_parameters() to order the result.

Usage

evaluate_state_parameters(
  g1bins_matrix,
  g1_granges,
  genome_granges,
  meta_data,
  param_grid,
  target_range = c(0.001, 0.2),
  infer_args = list(),
  assign_args = list(),
  qc_args = list(),
  n_cells = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  keep_results = FALSE,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

g1bins_matrix, g1_granges, genome_granges

As in assign_replication_states().

meta_data

A data.frame whose row names include all colnames(g1bins_matrix); it is reordered to the matrix columns.

param_grid

A data.frame with one row per combination; each column must be an argument of infer_single_cell_states() (e.g. init_ratio_lower and final_ratio_lower).

target_range

Numeric length-2 range of rep_percent counted as on target. We use c(0.001, 0.2).

infer_args

Named list of fixed arguments of infer_single_cell_states(); columns of param_grid take precedence. We use list(hmm_aggr_width = 15L).

assign_args

Named list of further arguments of assign_replication_states() (e.g. gap_max_bp, chunk_size).

qc_args

Named list of arguments of compute_rep_percent() (min_rep_percent, max_sigma, neighbor_window, outlier_threshold). We use list(min_rep_percent = 0.01, max_sigma = 0.3, neighbor_window = 5, outlier_threshold = 0.2).

n_cells

NULL (all cells) or the number of pilot cells sampled without replacement (matrix order is kept), e.g. 500.

seed

NULL or an integer seed for the pilot sampling.

keep_results

Logical; also return the compute_rep_percent() results (e.g. to plot rep_percent histograms).

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam, passed to both assign_replication_states() and compute_rep_percent().

verbose

Logical; print one message per combination. Default FALSE.

Value

A data.frame: the columns of param_grid, status ("ok" or "error"), error and the summary columns above. With keep_results = TRUE, the list of compute_rep_percent() results (NULL for failed rows) is attached as attribute "results". The pilot cells are attached as attribute "cells".

Details

Summary columns, with in_target = rep_percent within target_range (inclusive) and pass = pass_qc (NA counts as FALSE): n_total (cells), n_non_missing (non-NA rep_percent), n_target, n_pass_qc, target_prop_all_cells = n_target / n_total, target_prop_non_missing = n_target / n_non_missing, target_prop_pass_qc = sum(in_target & pass) / n_pass_qc, non_missing_prop, pass_qc_prop and runtime_min.

See also

rank_state_parameters()
